$comment: Site-owned. The single source of truth for site identity. src/kit/config.ts and every script in scripts/kit read this file; nothing site-specific is hardcoded anywhere else. canonicalHost is www by Beau's decision (2026-10-04), an explicit exception to the kit's apex default; the apex must 308 to www in Vercel.
name: D1 Picks
tagline: College sports predictions from a model that shows its work, graded in public.
description: Win probabilities, set-score odds and team ratings for D1 college sports, from a published model. Every prediction is logged before first serve and graded.

authors.name: D1 Picks Editorial Team
authors.bio: The D1 Picks editorial team publishes the ratings model, logs every prediction before first serve, grades it against the final score, and corrects errors when they are found.
